name: Counter Dashboard — Enter count, note, and save draft
description: Counter logs in with test_counter, opens item TS-ITEM-001, inputs counted balance 100, sets note and location, and saves draft.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page at /login
Enter test_counter into the username field and Test@123456 into the password field
Click on the item row with code TS-ITEM-001 to open its detail view
Enter 100 into the counted quantity input field
Enter شمارش دقیق انجام شد into the counter note input field
Click the Save Draft button labelled ذخیره موقت
Verify that the item details or table reflects the saved count of 100
